title: Constitution/Constants rollout: count fleet repositories committing .lore/schemas and write the release note (OPAG-425 R10)
description: Binding record: opum-doc main 7831fff, docs/adr/add-constitution-and-constants-document-types-to-lore.md, R10. Adding built-ins changes profileDigest, a fleet-wide rollout event: every repository committing .lore/schemas/ fails lore check with schema drift until it runs lore schema export. Before release, count (by ref, not working tree) the fleet repositories that commit .lore/schemas/, and ship the types in one lore minor release whose notes say so and name the remedy. opum-agent OPAG-425 AC4: the types ship in a lore release, with lore check validating a document of each type.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The count of fleet repositories committing .lore/schemas/ is measured by ref and recorded, with the repositories read
The release notes of the minor release carrying both types state the schema-drift rollout and the lore schema export remedy

implementationNotes: AC1 MEASUREMENT by ref, 2026-09-26 ~23:20Z. Method: git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/dev -- .lore/schemas, counting *.json, in each fleet repo after git fetch origin dev. 10 of 10 repos resolved: opum-agent 5f529012 (8), opum-doc 2673c827 (8), lore-cli 096466e3 (10), quest-cli 5bc386ea (8), opum-cli-e2e a73c66ea (8), lore-web ce2c0dcb (8), quest-web d7da8457 (8), opum-web 7eab1564 (8), opum-marketplace 8e5eec20 (8), opum-fleet 7e935d48 (8). RESULT: 10 of 10 commit .lore/schemas/; 9 hold the 8 pre-Constitution schemas; lore-cli holds 10, including constitution and constants. It agrees with an earlier pass at ~21:55Z. Consistent with the LCLI-606 AC2 run, where 9 of 10 repos already report 10 error-tier schema-drift findings each under a current lore. AC2: the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section, which becomes the next minor release notes, opens with an upgrade notice. It states that the digest change makes every committed .lore/schemas/ stale, that lore check exits 6 with schema-drift until lore schema export is run and committed, and that all 10 fleet repos need it in the same change that bumps their lore pin. It also records the LCLI-597 managed-block version dependency and Added entries for Constitution, Constants and the agents render. The release itself (a minor bump to 0.10.0, publication) is a separate action for the user.
